apps.name: Madeira
apps.subtitle: Windows games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: Windows games on iPhone and iPad. Nightly test build; source code for each build: github.com/camhoc/Madeira/releases
apps.versionDescription:
Madeira Nightly 0.2.180
Everything since 0.2.101 (the version number now matches the build number). This is a test build and has not been tested on a device yet: please send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks.

App
- Storage screen: see what uses space, remove several games at once, and choose whether their files go too
- Store pages: Install and Update work from the sheet, and it no longer reopens after you close it
- Remove from Library: the confirmation now appears on the page you are on
- Steam: pick the download server in Settings
- About: shows the version and whether a newer build exists
- Clearer default resolution label; overlays follow the screen's orientation

Controls
- Attempted fix for controllers that did nothing in Madeira but worked in other apps
- Option to swap A/B and X/Y on any controller
- The mouse stick can be turned off from the config

Game fixes (not yet tested on a device)
- Baldur's Gate 3: Madeira Dock starts the game without Larian's launcher
- Grounded: recommended settings start the game program directly
- Stray and other Unreal games: fix for the "Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime" box
- Resident Evil Requiem: new memory settings (turn off with pool-low = 0)
- Subnautica 2: settings against an early crash
- Fallout 4: fix for a crash shortly after Play
- RimWorld: attempt at the blank menu text
- Garry's Mod: opt-in fix for its folder check (env.MADEIRA_PLAIN_DIR_LINKS = 1)
- Madeira Dock: retries instead of failing with error 41; games whose program sits in a subfolder find their DLLs
- Elden Ring: can start without Easy Anti-Cheat (offline only)
- GTA IV: opt-in wait for its Rockstar launcher pipe
- Extra logging for Halo: MCC, R.E.P.O. and some crashes

Optional font: the app includes Liberation Sans (SIL Open Font License), renamed to "Arial", for games that show no text without it. It is off; turn it on with env.MADEIRA_ARIAL_FONT = 1.

Madeira Nightly 0.2.101
Everything since 0.2.100. Test build: send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks.

- Controller: claims controller input again if the first try at app start was too early
- Touch mode: a tap moves the pointer first, then clicks
- Left 4 Dead 2: downloaded Workshop add-ons are copied where the game looks for them
- Madeira Dock: games with no .exe launch option use the best non-beta Windows option
- Touch controls: a stick zone can move the mouse
- Touch controls: a stick zone can hold an extra action when pushed far
- Gyro aim: more activation buttons and an on-screen Gyro button
- Touch controls: buttons can latch and press a second key
- Touch controls: button opacity and colour
- Fix for the Visual C++ installer failing in some Unreal games
- Baldur's Gate 3 launcher: room for the fourth Chromium memory pool

Not yet device-tested.

Madeira Nightly 0.2.100
Everything since 0.2.95. Test build: send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks.

- New look: more screens use Apple's standard style
- Controllers on iPad: no more second (blue) highlight on menus
- DX12 games: newer KosmicKrisp, and compiled shaders are saved, so later launches start faster
- Steam: the Launch arguments field now works when "The game" is picked
- Touch camera: in Relative mode, finger camera follows your sensitivity setting
- Mouse lock (iPad): keeps asking again if iPadOS says no at first
- Tap to click: better timing for taps and tap-and-hold
- Game Dock: finds PhysX and other installers in every Steam library
- Raft reaches the main menu
- Left 4 Dead 2 start fix
- Batman: Arkham games reach the title screen with PhysX

Known: Baldur's Gate 3 and Black Ops 3 still close early.

Madeira Nightly 0.2.95 (build 173)
A nightly build for testers.

Contains code ported from MetalSharp (AGPL-3.0) by BOR1NG (Avery Felts), code from MetalSharp-Wine (LGPL-2.1) and MetalSharp's FEX patches (MIT), and from Mullion (LGPL-2.1-or-later). Full source for this build is on its release page.

Madeira Nightly 0.2.72 (build 150)
Everything big since 0.2.32.

- Wine 11.22, plus newer FEX and DXMT
- DirectX 12 games start and show a picture again
- Resident Evil Village plays full screen with its videos (use Wi-Fi)
- Slay the Spire 2 black screen fixed
- Deep Rock Galactic runs great on DX11 (DX12 doesn't start yet)
- LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga draws its world again
- Battle.net launcher opens again
- DirectX badge and Console look

Known: Overwatch 2 and Black Ops III don't get in game yet.

news.title: Madeira Nightly 0.2.180
news.caption: New: Storage screen, Steam download server choice, version check, store sheet and Remove from Library fixes, controller fixes. Attempts for Baldur's Gate 3, Grounded, Stray, Requiem, Fallout 4, RimWorld and Madeira Dock. Not yet device-tested: please send a log with Get Help if something breaks.

news.title: Madeira Nightly 0.2.101
news.caption: New: touch stick zones can move the mouse and hold an extra action, latching buttons, button opacity and colour, more gyro buttons. Fixes for taps, controller start-up, Left 4 Dead 2 Workshop add-ons, Madeira Dock launch options and the Visual C++ installer in some Unreal games. Not yet device-tested: please send a log with Get Help if something breaks.

news.title: Madeira Nightly 0.2.100
news.caption: New: more of Apple's standard look, no double highlight with controllers on iPad, faster DX12 starts (KosmicKrisp shader cache), Steam launch arguments, finger camera follows sensitivity in Relative mode, better tap-to-click. Raft reaches its menu, L4D2 start fix, Batman reaches the title screen. Known: BG3 and BO3 still close early. Please send a log with Get Help if something breaks.
